# LaunchLog full context

LaunchLog is a curated paid directory for indie makers, SaaS founders and tech launches.

Positioning: The log of what just shipped.

Canonical domain: https://launchlog.ai

## Audience

- Indie makers
- SaaS founders
- Developer-tool builders
- AI product builders
- Startup teams launching new tools

## Product model

LaunchLog publishes curated product listings. Each listing is intended to be reviewed, enriched and structured so search engines and answer engines can extract clear product facts.

## Pricing

- Basic: $24.99/year
- Premium: $59.99/year
- Featured: $99/year launch price, shown as discounted from $149/year

## Important public pages

- https://launchlog.ai/
- https://launchlog.ai/pricing
- https://launchlog.ai/browse-all
- https://launchlog.ai/featured
- https://launchlog.ai/tech-products
- https://launchlog.ai/submit
- https://launchlog.ai/sitemap.xml

## Technical search and AIO direction

LaunchLog public pages are built to be server-rendered and crawlable. Listing pages are planned to include schema.org JSON-LD graphs, canonical URLs and markdown variants for AI-readable extraction.

## Blog direction

LaunchLog blog content is planned to be generated and published through SEOAuto's WordPress publishing workflow, with WordPress serving canonical blog URLs under https://launchlog.ai/blog.

## Editorial rules

- Keep content factual and specific.
- Do not claim features are live until deployed.
- Prefer direct answers, clear headings, FAQ sections and structured data.
- Avoid generic AI filler and unsupported statistics.
